nodes.label: x-airflow-common (shared Airflow service template)
nodes.rationale: YAML anchor merged into every Airflow container so image (apache/airflow:3.3.1-python3.12), env (LocalExecutor, metadata DB conn, FANTAF1_DATABASE_URL, auth manager, Execution API URL, JWT secret), volumes (dags/logs/plugins/config/auth) and the postgres healthy dependency are declared once.

nodes.label: airflow-dag-processor
nodes.rationale: Runs `dag-processor`, a separate mandatory component in Airflow 3 (parsing DAGs from ./dags is no longer done by the scheduler).

nodes.label: airflow-init (db migrate + passwords.json bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: One-shot container: runs `airflow db migrate` then writes /opt/airflow/auth/passwords.json from AIRFLOW_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD so the SimpleAuthManager has credentials. Other services wait on service_completed_successfully.

nodes.label: airflow-scheduler
nodes.rationale: Runs `scheduler`; with LocalExecutor the task workers run inside this container and must reach the Execution API on airflow-webserver.

nodes.label: airflow-webserver (api-server, port 8080)
nodes.rationale: Runs the Airflow 3 `api-server` command (UI + REST + Execution API) exposed on host port 8080; named 'webserver' for familiarity though Airflow 3 replaced the webserver with api-server.

nodes.label: postgres (Airflow metadata DB service)
nodes.rationale: postgres:16 backing the Airflow metadata database; pg_isready healthcheck gates every Airflow container via depends_on service_healthy.

nodes.label: FANTAF1_DATABASE_URL (bridge to FantaF1 Django DB)
nodes.rationale: Passed through from the host .env so DAGs in ./dags can reach the FantaF1 application database, which is separate from the Airflow metadata postgres.

nodes.label: LocalExecutor
nodes.rationale: AIRFLOW__CORE__EXECUTOR=LocalExecutor: tasks execute as subprocesses of the scheduler, avoiding a Celery/worker cluster for this single-host learning setup.

nodes.label: Airflow 3 Execution API (task-to-server communication)
nodes.rationale: In Airflow 3 tasks no longer talk to the metadata DB directly; they go through the Execution API exposed by the api-server. AIRFLOW__CORE__EXECUTION_API_SERVER_URL is set to http://airflow-webserver:8080/execution/ because without it the worker looks for the API on localhost and fails.

nodes.label: Shared JWT secret (AIRFLOW__API_AUTH__JWT_SECRET)
nodes.rationale: The same AIRFLOW_JWT_SECRET must be present in every container (api-server, scheduler, dag-processor); otherwise Execution API calls fail with InvalidSignatureError.

nodes.label: SimpleAuthManager users/passwords file
nodes.rationale: Airflow 3 SimpleAuthManager: AIRFLOW__CORE__SIMPLE_AUTH_MANAGER_USERS grants the admin role to AIRFLOW_ADMIN_USERNAME, and passwords are read from /opt/airflow/auth/passwords.json (bind-mounted ./auth) which airflow-init generates at bootstrap.
